name: Rocky 7
def: JPL research microrover that added a camera mast and sampling arm to the Sojourner class design, field tested in the Mojave Desert.
body: Rocky 7 was a rocker bogie microrover used to prototype the science operations later flown on the Mars Exploration Rovers, including a deployable mast for panoramic imaging and a small arm with a scoop. Engineers ran it at Lavic Lake and other Mojave Desert sites, letting remote science teams plan each day's activity from returned images alone. The trials shaped how mission teams sequence a rover day and how much a rover can achieve between contacts.
facts: Prototyped mast based science operations later used on Mars
Used for remote science team field trials in the Mojave Desert
specs: Six wheel rocker bogie drive with two steered wheels
Deployable camera mast, stereo cameras, sampling arm and scoop
Waypoint driving with onboard hazard detection
